evaluations.claim: The green dash-dot line reaches 0.05 at layer 5 and stabilizes near 0.0 from layer 10 onward.
evaluations.reality: The green dash-dot line reaches approximately 0.1 at layer 5 and stays close to 0.0 from about layer 10 onward, not 0.05.

evaluations.reason: Green line lower than orange consistently.
